rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for alerting or notifying someone, including a gentle warning.

example.english: I warn you that it will rain heavily tonight, so remember to bring an umbrella.
example.traditional: 我提醒你，今晚會落大雨，記住帶遮。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tai4 seng2 nei5 gam1 maan5 wui5 lok6 daai6 jyu5 gei3 zyu6 daai3 ze1

rows.note: Use this casual construction when warning someone to watch out for danger.

example.english: I warn you to be careful.
example.jyutping: ngo5 giu3 nei5 siu2 sam1 di1 aa3

rows.note: Choose this for a stronger, explicit warning about danger, rules, or unacceptable behaviour.

example.english: The police warn residents not to go near the closed-off section of road.
example.traditional: 警方警告市民唔好行近封咗嘅路段。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 ging2 gou3 si5 man4 m4 hou2 haang4 gan6 fung1 zo2 ge3 lou6 dyun6

rows.note: Use this when warning someone off means telling them to leave or stay away.

example.english: I warn that drunk guy to go away, or I’ll call the police.
example.traditional: 我叫嗰個醉漢走開，唔係就報警。
example.jyutping: ngo5 giu3 go2 go3 zeoi3 hon3 zau2 hoi1 m4 hai6 zau6 bou3 ging2
